title: The Night Sky Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage stars night sky memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The night sky in Zimbabwe has no competition from the city
And the Milky Way is something more than just a word for pretty
The Southern Cross sits overhead as it always has
And the night sky doesn't care about the borders and the jazz

[Chorus]
The night sky Zimbabwe, the night sky Zimbabwe
No city glow to interrupt the full galactic show
The night sky Zimbabwe, the night sky Zimbabwe
The same stars my father watched from the same red ground below
The night sky Zimbabwe knows no boundary of the nation
The night sky Zimbabwe is the oldest form of education
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The children slept outside sometimes in the Zimbabwe summer
And woke up with the stars still present and the morning coming
And the understanding that the universe was large and close
And they were small and present — that was the most

[Bridge]
In Perth the stars are there but suburbs put a curtain
And the Milky Way appears only on the certain
Nights when cloud is absent and you drive out past the edge
Of the city to the ones who live upon the ridge

[Outro]
Zimbabwe night sky knows… the stars watched all of it…
The gardens still growing
